selectionPolicy: Hand-reviewed source top-face indices; no inferred geometry or movement of source vertices. Only Tai Chung and Sun Ki receive public walking acceptance from the current official Islands District guide.

I038171281003063C1.name: Tai Chung Bridge (Tai O Creek Pedestrian Bridge)

I039851299803063C0.name: Sun Ki Bridge

I039851299803063C0.floorSelectionNote: Deck and ramp top faces only. Suspension portals/cables, rail caps and lower slab faces excluded. OSM centreline has insufficient 0.55m edge clearance in places: use source deck geometry, not an unadjusted guided centreline.
